useCases.title: Keep an agent up when a provider goes down
useCases.summary: List backup models so an agent stays up
useCases.problem: An agent pinned to one model stops mid-task during a provider outage or a 429 burst. Retry loops in your code add latency and still hit the same provider.

snippets.code:
curl https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANYROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.4-mini",
    "models": ["anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6", "z-ai/glm-4.7-flash"],
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Plan the next step." }]
  }'
snippets.title: curl · models fallback
AI SDK

steps: Keep your primary model in model.
Add backup ids in models, in the order you want them tried. Fallbacks run on /api/v1/chat/completions.
Read the model field in the response to see which one answered. Or use anyrouter/auto and let AnyRouter pick a healthy model.
